title: Layout of the nested input encoding
statement: For bit strings $b,\alpha,x$, the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ is the physical clock prefix for $b$ followed by the pair encoding $\langle\alpha,x\rangle$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $b$, $\alpha$, $x$, the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ equals the physical clock prefix
of $b$ (each bit quadrupled, then the four cells $0011$) followed by the pair
encoding $\langle \alpha, x\rangle$.
